Vercel CLI 65.16.0
▲ vercel rollback <deployment> [options]
Roll back to a previous deployment

Commands:
  status [project]  Show the status of any current pending rollbacks

Options:
  --json            Output as JSON
  --timeout <TIME>  Time to wait for rollback completion (default: 3m)
  -y, --yes         Accept default value for all prompts

Global Options: See `vercel --help`

Examples:
  Rollback a deployment using id or url
    vercel rollback <DEPLOYMENT>
